newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian killed in demolition mishap.
newsitem.headline: Australian killed in demolition mishap.

text.p: An 23-year-old woman was killed and several people were injured in Canberra on Sunday when a hospital demolition went wrong, hurling debris into a crowd of thousands of spectators, police said.
Australian Federal Police acting sergeant Darryl Webb told Reuters the woman died during the implosion of the capital's old hospital, on the shore of a lake in tty's parliamentary tourist zone.
He said at least five people were injured. A 14-year-old boy suffered serious chest injuries.

The woman and those injured were standing in a park about 400 metres (yards) across the lake from the hospital, among thousands of tourists and locals who had lined parts of the lake and surrounding parks and bridges to watch the blast..
The hospital was closed in 1991 and was being demolished to clear the site for a new national museum.
